body.estimand_functional: \(\tau_n(z_0)=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{\mathbb E_P[\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0,E_0]-m_s(z_{0s})\}\), identified under \texttt{ass:event-transport} and estimated by the raw \(\widehat\tau\). The sharp \(R_\star\) risk and \(R_\star^{1/2}\) honest expected-length guarantees hold over \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\), the subclass adding exactly \texttt{ass:event-full-design-mean-stability} and \texttt{ass:historical-full-design-centering}; the donor lower bound additionally uses \texttt{ass:local-two-sided-modulus}.

sampling_model.design: Conditional on \(E_0\), each cohort contributes \(T\) exactly observed pre-event proxy paths with density bounded above and away from zero; the calendar process is geometrically beta mixing. The sharp upper and interval results additionally impose full-design centering of every historical regression error.
sampling_model.units: At every shared pre-event path, cohort \(s\) supplies \(n_s\) bounded response replicates, and the event date supplies \(n_s\) bounded treated wealth levels. Unit histories and event outcomes are independent across units conditional on the complete design and \(E_0\), while event and history variables for the same unit may remain dependent.
sampling_model.treatment: Consistency, limited anticipation, no spillovers, and the maintained cohort-average event-transport equality identify the causal target. For the sharp rates, event conditional means must also be stable given the complete historical design; this strong restriction is not implied by cross-unit independence.
sampling_model.overlap: The realized event path belongs to an interior positive-probability region, historical design densities are bounded below there, and donor displacements used by the modulus remain inside the declared local radius.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: An independent donor sample estimates only the event query under an unknown full heteroskedastic covariance; historical coordinates are exact. Donor-fold projected means and selected full-data local-polynomial fits form \(\widehat\tau\). Inference uses exact conditional bounded-summand radii for historical and event components, an observable Taylor allowance, and a fourth-moment full-covariance donor radius, with Bonferroni calibration.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The paper derives identification and asymptotic-bias conditions for financial event-study estimators and explains that buy-and-hold comparisons require volatility matching.
The Holder repeated-measurement prediction rate has sparse order \((nm)^{-2s/(2s+d)}\) and dense order \(n^{-1}\), up to the stated logarithmic qualifications.
A local-polynomial Lepski procedure adapts pointwise to local design mass and local Holder smoothness under observed random design.
Theorem 1 expands local-linear regression with a generated covariate attached to every training observation through smoothed first-stage errors.
Theorems 3.1--3.6 establish deconvolution rates when latent training coordinates have replicated classical measurement error.
Theorems 7--8 evaluate a rate-optimal local-polynomial regression estimator at a sample-split estimated strongly convex minimizer.
The dependent-data theorem uses large-block--small-block coupling for conditional approximation of synthetic-control prediction error.
Spline and wavelet series estimators attain optimal uniform rates and functional normality under beta mixing and weak moments.
Ordered moduli characterize optimal confidence procedures for linear functionals over convex regression classes in a fixed Gaussian experiment.
The many-period--many-control result gives conditions for synthetic-control factor-loading recovery under imperfect pre-treatment fit.
The proximal synthetic-control theorems identify treatment effects by using excluded control outcomes as predetermined proxies.

body.tldr: The target is the cohort-weighted finite-cohort causal buy-and-hold level-wealth effect at a realized event path. A maintained event-transport restriction identifies it from the full historical wealth-path regression, and the raw generated-center local-polynomial estimator is exactly a foldwise weighted-panel event coefficient. The original panel-law class is too broad: a shared design-measurable component can defeat replication and any vanishing honest expected length. On the transparent subclass \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\), which adds the two explicit strong full-design mean-stability and error-centering restrictions, the sharp risk is \(R_\star\) and the sharp honest expected-length rate is \(R_\star^{1/2}\). A full-data interval combines exact bounded-summand historical and event radii, observable Holder bias, and a full-covariance fourth-moment donor allowance. The positive-probability joint causal-panel embedding supplies matching treated, smoothing, spacing, and donor lower bounds; only affinity, not bounded Kullback--Leibler divergence, is claimed for spacing.

project_justification.gap: Existing causal financial event-study, repeated-measurement regression, generated-regressor, and synthetic-control interval results do not jointly cover a realized external donor center, shared calendar design, finite-cohort causal identification, and an all-relative-growth minimax and honest-length frontier. The unrepaired panel class also shows why conditional cross-unit independence alone is insufficient for replication rates.
project_justification.niche: The design observes historical proxy coordinates exactly, replicates untreated wealth responses at shared calendar sites, and estimates only the event query from an independent donor universe. The analysis makes the required full-design strict-exogeneity and centering restrictions explicit instead of attributing them to weaker contemporaneous or cross-unit conditions.
project_justification.fill: The project proves event-transport identification, an exact raw-estimator FWL representation, positive-probability joint causal-panel lower-bound embeddings, and sharp risk and honest expected-length frontiers on \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\). The attaining interval uses the full-data estimator with exact bounded-summand radii, Taylor bias, and full-covariance donor calibration, including sparse spacing regimes without a block-multiplier approximation.

body.related_work: Goldsmith-Pinkham and Lyu motivate causal financial panels and the volatility sensitivity of compounded wealth; causal identification here still rests on the maintained event-transport equality. Yan, Yao, and Zhou and Gaiffas inform repeated-response and pointwise random-design smoothing, while Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle and Delaigle, Hall, and Meister clarify why an estimated external query differs from generated training coordinates or classical measurement error. Cattaneo, Feng, and Titiunik motivate separating stochastic and approximation uncertainty, but the final interval does not invoke retained-block multipliers. Chen and Christensen inform weak-dependence Gram control. Armstrong and Kolesar motivate honest expected-length comparisons, while the present lower bound is embedded in positive-probability causal panel laws. The field-tier additions are the exact FWL identity, joint-law embedding, higher-smoothness donor saturation, and all-relative-regime frontier on the explicitly full-design-centered subclass.
body.technical_internal_limitation: Causal identification remains conditional on the maintained event-transport equality. The donor converse remains conditional on the assumed two-sided local modulus, which excludes flat surfaces and is not derived for the whole Holder ball. Sharp risk and honest expected length are proved only over \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\), whose event full-design mean stability and historical full-design error centering are explicit strong restrictions and are not consequences of conditional cross-unit independence or contemporaneous regression. The obstruction proposition shows that the original class cannot support either advertised vanishing rate. Mean-only return-path nonidentification concerns only \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{mean}}\), not equivalence of the full historical wealth panels.
body.honest_scope: The proved contribution comprises the positive-probability joint causal-panel embedding, event-transport identifying map, exact raw-estimator FWL representation, higher-smoothness donor saturation, and sharp all-relative-growth risk and honest expected-length frontiers on \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\). The original panel-law class remains subject to the shared-design replication obstruction; no alternative interval is claimed to repair its \(R_\star^{1/2}\) rate. The donor lower bound assumes the two-sided local modulus. The result does not claim event-date exchangeability, identification from mean-only return matching, smoothness adaptation, sharp phase-intersection constants, growing cohort count, or growing proxy-path dimension.
